description: Oil and Gas Pipelines is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. This resource is a map of the oil and gas pipelines. atlas. gov. au/datasets/digitalatlas::gas-pipelines/about The Oil and Gas Pipelines Database contains known spatial locations of onshore and offshore pipelines or pipeline corridors used to transport natural gas, oil and other liquids within Australias mainland and territorial waters. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are Oil and Gas. It offers 3 resource(s) in png, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-06-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
